name: nextgen-ai-voiceover
description: English-first Kokoro voiceover studio for web, Windows, macOS, Linux and Android

scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/pwa.js && node --check src/lib/text.js && node --check src/lib/pronunciation.js && node --check src/lib/voice-catalog.js && node --check src/lib/narration.js && node --check src/lib/paragraph-editor.js && node --check src/lib/subtitles.js && node --check src/lib/audio-processing.js && node --check src/lib/audio-metadata.js && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check scripts/check-build.js && node --check scripts/check-platform-build.js && node --check scripts/build-site.js && node --check scripts/pages-smoke-test.js && node scripts/check-platform-build.js
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.android:prepare: npm run build && cap add android && cap sync android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
